name: Frontier Lithium Inc.
summary: Frontier Lithium Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mining properties in Canada. It explores for lithium, cesium, tantalum, and rubidium metals. The company primarily holds a 100% interest in the PAK Lithium project, which covers 1,378 contiguous mining claim units totaling 26,774 hectares located in northwestern Ontario, Canada. It has a strategic partnership agreement with XPS Expert Process Solutions to develop a process to refine spodumene concentrate into lithium hydroxide. The company was formerly known as Houston Lake Mining Inc. and changed its name to Frontier Lithium Inc. in May 2016. Frontier Lithium Inc. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Val Caron, Canada.
